name: The Phoenician
positioning: The Phoenician, a Luxury Collection Resort, Scottsdale: a desert resort on 250 acres at the base of Camelback Mountain, with a three-level pool complex, a rooftop spa pool and an 18-hole golf course
best_for: Travelers who want a desert resort base at the foot of Camelback Mountain
Spa-goers looking for hydrotherapy and a rooftop pool with mountain views
Golfers and families who want pools, a waterslide and a golf course on site

facts.text: The resort sits on 250 acres at the base of Camelback Mountain.
Old Town Scottsdale is a quick and easy ride from the resort.
The resort has a three-level pool complex.
The Phoenician Spa covers 40,000 square feet with more than two dozen treatment rooms.
The spa recommends beginning a visit with hot-and-cold contrast hydrotherapy.
The 18-hole Phoenician Golf Club is a par-71 course designed by Phil Smith, with four sets of tees.
All accommodations include balconies or patios.
Rooms feature Italian marble, pillowtop mattresses and Frette linens.
Casitas sit opposite the main building, separated by The Phoenician Pools and Necklace Lake, each with doorstep parking.
The historic Jokake Inn stands just inside the resort grounds.
The Kids Zone has a twisting waterslide, a children's tree house with a swaying bridge and a splash pad.
J&G Steakhouse has big views from its fifth-floor location.

highlights.text: The signature Mother of Pearl Pool is hand-laid in Mother of Pearl tiles.
The spa's rooftop pool has views of both the resort and Camelback Mountain.
A two-acre cactus garden along the northern edge of the grounds features 250 varieties of cacti.
The resort displays 11 sculptures by Native American artist Allan Houser (Haozous).
Private poolside cabanas come with a dedicated service member.

considerations.text: A daily resort fee is posted to each guestroom.
Casitas are about a 300-yard walk from the main building.
The minimum age to check in is 18.
